extras: Requires Obsidian Desktop and local filesystem vault; symlink behavior may vary on iCloud/sync folders.
intentEvidence: Obsidian plugin that links external files and folders into your vault using symbolic links (ln -s on macOS/Linux).
problem: Users need a way to reference external files and directories within their vault without physically copying the data into the vault.
summary: LNS Directories links external files and folders into the vault using symbolic links, allowing them to appear in the Obsidian file explorer without copying data.
